title: Bulk delete session recordings
description: Delete a batch of session recordings by session ID, up to 100 per call. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone — confirm with the user before deleting. Prefer this over `session-recording-delete` whenever more than one recording needs deleting: find the target IDs with `query-session-recordings-list`, then delete in batches. Pass `date_from` (e.g. '-30d') when the recordings' age is known — it makes the lookup much faster. IDs with no matching recording are skipped, so a `deleted_count` below `total_requested` is normal when some recordings were already deleted or never existed.

methodDocumentation.text: Delete a batch of session recordings by session ID. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. IDs that don't match an existing recording are skipped and counted in `total_requested` but not `deleted_count`.
